fact: In an interview with the Agence gabonaise de presse on 23 October 2026, the digital economy minister said Gabon will authorise providers such as Starlink and Eutelsat in the coming months, and the article notes that ARCEP stated in October 2025 that Starlink held no authorisation to provide services in Gabon.
title: Gabon : Starlink et Eutelsat bientôt autorisés à fournir Internet ?
